title: Reference approach: NumPy Image Processor
approach: Validate external input shape, dtype, and fields before numerical work.
Use ndarray operations and choose explicit axes and tolerance rules.
Separate loading, transformation, analysis, and reporting into testable functions.
Use synthetic fixtures and test invalid/boundary cases.
Record assumptions, environment versions, and performance measurements.
acceptance_guidance: Normalize or clip pixel intensities with an explicit dtype policy.
Compare before/after shapes and demonstrate a reversible or explained transform.
explanation: Apply transparent numerical transformations to small image-like arrays. This is a reference approach, not a complete executable deliverable. Final reference code and tests require technical review before release.
